visualCharacteristics.purpose: Text-only promo cards, each with its own solid background color and white text
visualCharacteristics.description: Three solid-color tiles (indigo #3d4f96, blue #006fb1, teal #2e807d) with white eyebrow, white uppercase condensed title, white body, uppercase arrow link.

contentPattern.summary: Text-only promo cards, each with its own solid background color and white text.
contentPattern.structure: one row per card. Optional image cell; text cell with eyebrow paragraph, title (heading), description and a trailing CTA link. Extra text cells are merged into the body
contentPattern.sourceContent: 3 look-alike promo items: eyebrow, title, description, CTA link

usage: Homepage promo row: Sostenibilita, Innovazione, Sistema elettrico.
reuseGuidance: Use for colored text promos with eyebrow and CTA. For plain linked navigation tiles use cards-nav.
